## Summary

Main-push commit validation accepts long GitHub noreply co-author trailers on squash commits. The 100-character limit still applies to other footer lines.

## Evidence

- **Before** · [Post-merge Quality](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/actions/runs/44997919401) rejected the trailer GitHub added to the v0.8.1 squash landing.
- **After** · The exact failed commit range passes. The regression test accepts a long GitHub co-author trailer and rejects a long breaking-change footer. All 28 commit-message tests passed.
- The complete verification suite passed in the commit hook, including the packaged CLI fixture, architecture checks and docs build.

## Merge Danger

**Door** · Reversible in a follow-up PR.

**Blast radius** · Main-push commit-message checks.

## Release context

```release-log
impact: GitHub-generated trailers on squash commits no longer fail Quality solely for their length.

```
